messages:
sophia: Hey all — first week question: I need to toggle a feature flag in staging for the payments flow test. Who should I ask for Redwood Console staging admin access? I'm on ENG-ML and don't have the console link yet.

samir: @sophia welcome! you should get staging admin first. Please open a JIRA to INFRA-ACCESS (project INFRA) with `component: console` and tag your manager. For quick access we have JIT: https://access.internal.redwood/jit — select 'Console - Staging' and request an 8h window. Security auto-approves for most staging requests unless it touches PCI services. :white_check_mark:

sophia: Thanks! Do I need any specific group or SSO claim? I'm on SAML via Okta.

irene: You'll need the `rdw-console-staging-admin` role to toggle flags. Manager approval + one infra approver are required for staging. Prod is extra: security review + biz owner signoff. Also subscribe to #experiments if you'll run A/Bs.

eli: If you want to avoid waiting for full admin rights, use the preview CLI to validate flags locally: 
```
ffctl preview --env staging --flag payments_v2 --user test123
```
That only queries the flag eval and doesn't require UI perms.

sophia: Perfect — I filed INFRA-12345 and used the JIT link. Pinged @samir for infra approver. What's the console URL for staging?

samir: staging-console.redwood.internal/login (SSO). If JIT is approved I can add the role from the admin panel. @onboarding-bot, please annotate the ticket for an access grant once INFRA-12345 is approved.

onboarding-bot: Noted — will log access event once INFRA-12345 status changes to "approved" and will notify the thread.

sophia: Approved! I have the `rdw-console-staging-admin` role now. Quick Q: where's the feature flags page? can't find it.

irene: Top-left nav -> Operations -> Feature Flags. If you don't see "Operations" check user settings and enable "beta-nav". If still missing, LMK and I can impersonate and debug.

sophia: Found it, can toggle in staging. Ran a quick smoke test against the payments sandbox, looks good. Thanks everyone! :tada:

samir: Awesome — one last note: for any toggle that affects billing or user sessions, add a short rollback plan in the JIRA ticket and tag @support for monitoring. Also schedule a 1:1 demo with DevEx later this week so we can show best practices.

sophia: Will do, thanks again all!
